The '''Arena Grand''' was the main gladiatorial arena of [[Zakuul]]. Located in the [[Old World]], it featured fights between Zakuulans, off-worlders, creatures and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were broadcast as entertainment and source for betting across the Eternal Empire. The current winner of all matches in the arena held the title of the "Eternal Champion".<ref name="SWTOR" /> By [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.4}}</ref> this title was held by [[Zotar]], a [[Knights of Zakuul|Knight of Zakuul]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Arena Grand appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the Eternal Championship.<ref name="SWTOR" />
